messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

John, nothing has changed since we last spoke. Shop···· is paid and hasn't shipped yet. Your Magic M. 40T is waiting on stock at our US warehouse, and your Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA add-on is on the same order.

Magic M. expects the units to ship out from the factory on November 12, which is today. Once your miner ships to you, the tracking goes straight to (email hidden), so you don't need to check back here for it. It's worth adding us to your contacts so it doesn't end up in spam.

You can follow that shipment on its way to our warehouse at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Is there something about the order that's worrying you? I'm happy to help with that.
What is is being shipped on my batch (5) of the magic miner 40t? I'm now reading that harlo os is NOT on the newer models?

John, your order has two things on it: the Magic M. 40T and the Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA add-on. That add-on gives you a 3-month RMA plus a diagnosis by our technical team. It doesn't include Harlo OS. All 300 units are being built and shipped together now, so every 40T is the same hardware.

You're right about Harlo OS. The 40T runs Magic M.'s own stock firmware. It has three presets: about 30 TH/s, 36 TH/s (standard) and 42 TH/s (turbo). All three are normal use and covered by the warranty. Harlo OS isn't being developed for any miner right now. The team is working on an alternative and will share news when it's ready.

Does that change anything for you on this order?
What os is on batch 5 (my batch) of magic miner 40t? I'm reading that the harlo os is NOT on the newer models?

John, batch 5 ships with Magic M. OS, the manufacturer's own firmware. Harlo OS isn't on batch 5 or on any other batch. Every 40T is the same hardware with the same firmware, whatever batch it came from.

What you're reading is right. Harlo OS isn't being developed for any miner right now, so it won't be on your unit. The team is working on an alternative and will share news when it's ready.

On Magic M. OS you can pick about 30, 36 or 42 TH/s. All three settings are normal use and covered by the warranty.

Was Harlo OS a big part of why you chose this miner?

That's fair, John. You bought this miner partly for Harlo OS, and now it won't run it. I'm sorry that changed after you ordered.

The hardware hasn't changed, though. Your 40T is still the best value per TH we sell. On its own firmware it runs up to about 42 TH/s at around 690 W, as normal use, with the warranty intact.

What were you counting on Harlo OS for? Was it the higher hashrate modes, pool or solo setup, or the dashboard? Tell me and I'll check what the stock firmware can do for that.
